description_en: Queries the details of a specified scaling group, such as the basic information, instances in the scaling group, and scaling configurations. For Elastic Container Instance (ECI) scaling groups, if the OutputFormat parameter is set to YAML, the output is returned in the Kubernetes Deployment YAML format
description_zh: 您可以通过调用API DescribeScalingGroupDetail查询该伸缩组详情，例如，查看指定伸缩组的基本信息、伸缩组内实例、伸缩配置等信息。当ECI类型的伸缩组指定OutputFormat参数为YAML时，可以输出Kubernetes Deployment YAML格式内容
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-group-detail --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingGroupDetail

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属的地域ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The output format. Only the YAML format is supported
parameters.help_zh: Output输出格式，现仅支持YAML格式
parameters.name: output_format

Output.description_en: The output details of the ECI scaling group. Currently, only the Kubernetes Deployment YAML format is supported
Output.description_zh: ECI伸缩组输出详情。目前仅支持Kubernetes Deployment YAML格式输出
Output.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
  labels:
    app: nginx
  spec:
    replicas: 3
    selector:
       matchLabels:
        app: nginx
    template:
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: nginx
        annotations:
          k8s.aliyun.com/eip-bandwidth: 10
          k8s.aliyun.com/eci-with-eip: true
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: nginx
            image: nginx:1.14.2
            ports:
            - containerPort: 80

items.description_zh: ALB服务器组的相关信息集合

AllocationStrategy.description_en:
The capacity allocation strategy, which determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet the capacity requirements. The capacity distribution strategy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacities. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

priority: Creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: Creates instances based on the unit price of vCPUs from low to high
AllocationStrategy.description_zh:
容量分配策略，决定了伸缩组如何选择可用的实例规格类型满足容量。容量分布策略同时对按量和抢占式容量生效（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。可能值：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例

AzBalance.description_en:
Indicates whether the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

true: The capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones.
false: The capacity of the scaling group is not evenly distributed across multiple zones
AzBalance.description_zh:
伸缩组的容量是否在多个可用区间均衡分布（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效），可能值：

true：伸缩组的容量在多个可用区间均衡分布。
false：伸缩组的容量不在多个可用区间均衡分布

CompensateWithOnDemand.description_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the requirement for the number of ECS instances when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COST_OPTIMIZED and spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory issues. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
CompensateWithOnDemand.description_zh:
当`MultiAZPolicy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。可能值：

true：允许。
false：不允许

CreationTime.description_zh: 伸缩组的创建时间，采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

ECS: The scaling group manages ECS instances.

ECI: The scaling group manages ECI instances
GroupType.description_zh:

HealthCheckType.description_en:
The health check mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

NONE: No health check is performed.
ECS: Performs health checks on instances in the scaling group. Both ECS and ECI scaling groups use this value to enable instance health checks.
LOAD_BALANCER: Determines the health status of instances based on the health check results of load balancing (the CLB load balancing type is not supported)
HealthCheckType.description_zh:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。可能值：

NONE：不做健康检查。
ECS：对伸缩组内的实例做健康检查（ECS类型和ECI类型的伸缩组均使用本取值开启实例健康检查）。
LOAD_BALANCER: 根据负载均衡（暂不支持clb负载均衡类型）健康检查结果判断实例健康状态

HealthCheckTypes.description_en:

LOAD_BALANCER: Determines the health status of instances based on the health check results of load balancing (the CLB load balancing type is not currently supported)

LOAD_BALANCER: Determines the health status of instances based on the health check results of load balancing (the CLB load balancing type is not currently supported)
items.description_zh:

WeightedCapacity.description_en: The weight of the instance type, which indicates the capacity of a single instance of this type in the scaling group. A higher weight means fewer instances of this type are required to meet the expected capacity

LifecycleState.description_en:
The lifecycle state of the scaling group. Valid values:

Active: The scaling group is active. Only active scaling groups can accept requests to execute scaling rules and trigger a scaling activity.

Inactive: The scaling group is inactive. Inactive scaling groups do not accept any requests to execute scaling rules.

Deleting: The scaling group is being deleted. Scaling groups in the deleting state do not accept any requests to execute scaling rules, and their parameters cannot be modified
LifecycleState.description_zh:
伸缩组的状态信息。可能值：

Active：生效状态，处于生效状态的伸缩组才能接收执行伸缩规则的请求并触发伸缩活动。

Inactive：失效状态，处于失效状态的伸缩组不接收任何执行伸缩规则的请求。

Deleting：伸缩组正在删除，处于删除中状态的伸缩组不接收任何执行伸缩规则的请求，并且不能修改伸缩组相关参数

Default value: null.

实例在伸缩组中存活的最大时间。单位为秒。

MonitorGroupId.description_zh: 伸缩组关联的云监控应用分组ID

MultiAZPolicy.description_en:
The scale-out and scale-in policy for ECS instances in a scaling group with multiple active zones. Valid values:
         
PRIORITY: Scales instances based on the vSwitches (VSwitchIds) that you defined. If an ECS instance cannot be created in the zone of the vSwitch with the highest priority, the system automatically uses the vSwitch with the next highest priority to create the ECS instance.

COST_OPTIMIZED: Attempts to create instances in ascending order of vCPU unit price. If the scaling configuration specifies multiple instance types and the billing method is set to spot instance, the system preferentially creates spot instances. You can use the CompensateWithOnDemand parameter to specify whether to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances when spot instances cannot be created due to insufficient inventory or other reasons.
The COST_OPTIMIZED policy takes effect only when the scaling configuration specifies multiple instance types or uses spot instances.

BALANCE: Evenly allocate ECS instances across the multiple active zones specified for the scaling group. If the distribution becomes unbalanced across zones due to insufficient inventory or other reasons, you can call the RebalanceInstance operation to balance the resources
MultiAZPolicy.description_zh:
多可用区伸缩组ECS实例扩缩容策略。可能值：
         
PRIORITY：根据您定义的虚拟交换机（VSwitchIds）扩缩容。当优先级较高的虚拟交换机所在可用区无法创建ECS实例时，自动使用下一优先级的虚拟交换机创建ECS实例。

COST_OPTIMIZED：按vCPU单价从低到高进行尝试创建。当伸缩配置设置了抢占式计费方式的多实例规格时，优先创建对应抢占式实例。您可以继续通过CompensateWithOnDemand参数指定当抢占式实例由于库存等原因无法创建时，是否自动尝试以按量付费的方式创建。
COST_OPTIMIZED仅在伸缩配置设置了多实例规格或者选用了抢占式实例的情况下生效。

BALANCE：在伸缩组指定的多可用区之间均匀分配ECS实例。如果由于库存不足等原因可用区之间变得不平衡，您可以通过API RebalanceInstance平衡资源

OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group is less than this value, the system preferentially creates pay-as-you-go instances
OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_zh: 已有伸缩组内所需要的按量实例数的最小值，可能值：0~1000。即当伸缩组内按量实例个数少于该最小值时，系统将优先创建按量实例

OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances specified by OnDemandBaseCapacity. Valid values: 0 to 100
OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组满足最小按量实例数（ondemandbasecapacity）要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100

PendingCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are being added to the scaling group but have not completed the relevant configurations
PendingCapacity.description_zh: 正在加入伸缩组，还未完成相关配置的ECS实例的数量

PendingWaitCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are pending addition to the scaling group
PendingWaitCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于加入挂起状态的ECS实例的数量

ProtectedCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are in the protected state in the scaling group
ProtectedCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于保护中状态的ECS实例的数量

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the scaling group

RemovalPolicies.description_en: The policies for removing instances from the scaling group
RemovalPolicies.description_zh: 实例移出伸缩组的策略的集合

items.description_en:
The policy for removing ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:
OldestInstance: Removes the instance that was created earliest.
NewestInstance: Removes the instance that was created most recently.
OldestScalingConfiguration: Removes the instance that was created earliest based on the scaling configuration
items.description_zh:
ECS实例移出伸缩组的策略的集合。可能值：
OldestInstance：移出最早创建的实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新创建的实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早由伸缩配置创建的实例

RemovingCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are being removed from the scaling group
RemovingCapacity.description_zh: 正在移出伸缩组的ECS实例的数量

RemovingWaitCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于移除挂起状态的ECS实例的数量

The ID of the resource group to which the newly created scaling group belongs.
Assigns the newly created scaling group to the specified resource group. If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling group belongs to the default resource group

新创建的伸缩组所属的资源组ID。
将新创建的伸缩组归属到指定的资源组中。如果不指定该参数，则归属为默认资源组

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

ScalingGroupName.description_en:
The name of the scaling group. The name must be unique within a region.

The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a digit, a letter, or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
ScalingGroupName.description_zh:
伸缩组的名称，同一地域下伸缩组名称唯一。

长度为2~64个字符，以数字、大小英文字母或中文开头，可以包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）

ScalingPolicy.description_en:
The reclaim mode of the scaling group. Valid values:
         
recycle: The scaling group uses the shutdown and reclaim mode.
release: The scaling group uses the release mode.
forcerelease: The scaling group uses the force release mode.
forcerecycle: The scaling group uses the force shutdown and reclaim mode.

For more information about the actions on removed instances, see [RemoveInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html）
ScalingPolicy.description_zh:
指定伸缩组的回收模式。可能值：
         
recycle：伸缩组的回收模式为停机回收模式。
release：伸缩组的回收模式为释放模式。
forcerelease：伸缩组的回收模式为强制释放模式。
forcerecycle：伸缩组的回收模式为强制停机回收模式。

关于被移出实例的动作，请参见[RemoveInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html）

ServerGroups.description_en:
The information about the load balancing server groups.

You can use this parameter to obtain information about the ALB service groups, NLB server groups, and GWLB service groups associated with the scaling group
ServerGroups.description_zh:
负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合。

您可以通过此参数获取伸缩组关联的ALB类型服务组、NLB类型服务器组和GWLB类型服务组的相关信息集合

items.description_zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合

Weight.description_zh: 弹性伸缩将实例添加到服务器组后，实例作为后端服务器的权重

The capacity allocation strategy, which determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet the capacity requirements. The capacity distribution strategy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacities. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

priority: Creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: Creates instances based on the unit price of vCPUs from low to high
SpotAllocationStrategy.description_zh:
容量分配策略，决定了伸缩组如何选择可用的实例规格类型满足容量。容量分布策略同时对按量和抢占式容量生效（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。可能值：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例

SpotInstancePools.description_en: The number of available instance types that are specified. The scaling group creates spot instances across the specified instance types that have the lowest costs. Valid values: 0 to 10
SpotInstancePools.description_zh: 指定可用实例规格的个数，伸缩组将按成本最低的多个规格均衡创建抢占式实例。取值范围：0~10

SpotInstanceRemedy.description_en: Indicates whether the spot instance replenishment feature is enabled. After this feature is enabled, when the scaling group receives a system message that a spot instance will be reclaimed, the scaling group attempts to create a new instance to replace the spot instance to be reclaimed
SpotInstanceRemedy.description_zh: 是否开启补齐抢占式实例。开启后，当收到抢占式实例将被回收的系统消息时，伸缩组将尝试创建新的实例，替换掉将被回收的抢占式实例

StoppedCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于节省停机效果的实例数量

SuspendedProcesses.description_en:

ScaleIn: The scale-in process.
